name: Woodland Manufacturing

about:
Woodland Manufacturing operates from Meridian, Idaho, where it was founded in 2003 as a limited liability company. The business began in a garage with computer-guided saws nicknamed "The Beast," cutting wooden letters for custom signage.

Today the shop produces custom sign letters, plaques, and event displays using wood, metal (aluminum, bronze, steel, brass, copper), plastic (acrylic, foam, formed and injection-molded), and vinyl. In-house capabilities include CNC routing, laser cutting, water jet cutting, vinyl cutting, and media production. The company describes its workshop as stocked and its capabilities as virtually limitless, though it does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volumes.

Customers range from businesses, churches, and government offices to industrial shops and event organizers. The company notes that its clients often have a DIY attitude and confidence in designing and installing their own signage, and it supports them with installation guides and finishing tutorials.

Woodland Manufacturing emphasizes that it carries no stock inventory; every letter is handcrafted per order. It promises quotes within one business day and highlights friendly customer service, design expertise, and experienced artisans as the foundation of its approach.
